reviews.comment: No blinky lights, just fast(ish) DDR5 memory.  A reasonably priced set of DIMMs (If there is such a thing these days) that perform well.
reviews.author: M G M Jr

reviews.title: Recognized by motherboard, XMP capable, and more than enough for big title games.
reviews.comment: As someone who builds custom PC’s and loves playing demanding big title games like COD Black Ops 6, GTA V, Dying Light Series, etc, I’m always on the lookout for new products to upgrade my rig. The sleek black looks high quality and has a nice weight to it, installation is as simple as pushing into the corresponding RAM slots on the motherboard, it’s only compatible with motherboards that use DDR5, and the 6000MT/s and CAS Latency of 36 are plenty fast to run any game. I bought these DDR5 G.SKILL RAM sticks to upgrade my 64GB DDR4 RAM as my new motherboard is only compatible with DDR5 RAM. I originally wanted 64GB, but that was a little out of budget for me at the moment, but 32GB is plenty to get great performance on an game as long as you’re other PC parts allow it to be used at full potential. I got on sale for about $83, which is great price for 32GB of DDR5 RAM from a reputable company. Great buy overall.
reviews.author: Carlos Paredes III

reviews.title: PC Builder
reviews.comment: Purchased this a few years ago to replace and upgrade my aging gaming rig. I'm familiar with G.Skill and their popularity and so far it has not disappointed. No issues relating to the RAM itself, but there were a few issues that some long awaited bios updates eventually fixed. I believe I finally have XMP working now too. I'm not an RGB lights type of computer person, so the sleek low profile all black ram is exactly what I was looking for, and it fits perfectly under my Noctua CPU cooler.
reviews.author: zombird

reviews.title: Highly recommended, fast and stable
reviews.comment: I needed low profile memory to fit underneath my cpu heatsink, and RGB is silly. If that sounds like you, this is a perfect product. No nonsense, super fast and low latency RAM. I used this to replace a 32GB (2x16GB) kit of flare x5 ram.  I was primarily looking to increase capacity without sacrificing speed, there was nothing wrong with the old kit. I initially had some instability issues with my gigabyte Z690 Aorus master mother board and i5-13600k cpu. Happy to report that a BIOS update to the latest version fixed all issues and it is stable as a rock (aka issue was motherboard, not the RAM itself.) This is my ~6th pc build since 2005. This is my second flawless ddr5 g.skill brand kit; they have earned a repeat customer.
reviews.author: brad

reviews.title: Great 64gb sticks in 2024, not 2025
reviews.comment: They work great! Not $700 great, but I'm glad I bought these when I upgraded my motherboard in 2024 😅 They fit just right in my case for me to put a giant air cooler over them so no problems there. But seriously, this would be a 1 for me PERSONALLY if I was looking to upgrade to 64gb TODAY (November 2025). These aren't even new sticks.
